name: True Seeing

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

components.m: mushroom powder worth 25+ GP, which the spell consumes

summary: A willing creature you touch gains Truesight out to 120 feet.
text: It sees in magical and normal darkness, sees invisible creatures and objects, spots visual illusions and shape-changers, and sees into the Ethereal Plane.
